role: independent individual-level mechanism gate; separate from the locked Pygoscelis colony-history panel

sources_to_audit.dataset: Adelie penguin resighting data 1997-2021 from the California Avian Data Center hosted by Point Reyes Bird Observatory Conservation Science
Adelie penguin banding data 1994-2021 from the California Avian Data Center hosted by Point Reyes Bird Observatory Conservation Science
Adelie penguin chick counts 1997-2009 from the California Avian Data Center hosted by Point Reyes Bird Observatory Conservation Science
sources_to_audit.role: candidate local reproductive-output source only; chick counts alone are not accepted as colony performance unless an alignable adult breeding-pair denominator is found

known_from_metadata_before_freeze: The Ross/Beaufort program explicitly studies geographic structure, colony growth, emigration and immigration.
Longitudinal resighting data span 1997-2021 and banding data span 1994-2021.
The resight dataset is classified as mark-recapture monitoring.
No eligible repeated local adult-abundance source has yet been identified by the frozen external-panel search.

allowed: file names, sizes, checksums and formats
whether a stable individual identifier exists
whether breeding status, age, sex, nest status or individual reproductive outcome fields exist
whether repeated local adult abundance and reproductive performance can be aligned from a public companion dataset
prohibited: association of any prior success measure with movement
selection of years, individuals or colonies based on observed movement or reproductive outcomes

gate_decisions.GO_PERFORMANCE_LINKED_MOVEMENT: Require stable individual ID; season/year; origin/prior colony; subsequent observed colony/location; and an independently interpretable local colony-performance state measured before movement. The performance state must use a documented reproductive denominator or a directly supplied reproductive-success metric, not raw chick count alone.
gate_decisions.GO_MOVEMENT_ONLY_DATA_DEPENDENCY: Individual ID and longitudinal colony/location are sufficient for movement inference, but no valid colony-performance predictor is available. Freeze the source as a future dependency; do not test the performance mechanism.
gate_decisions.GO_OWN_SUCCESS_DISPERSAL_SEPARATE_HYPOTH: If individual-level own breeding success and subsequent location exist but no colony-level public-performance source exists, this may support a separate own-success dispersal hypothesis only after a new contract is frozen before values are opened.
gate_decisions.STOP: Stable individual linkage or longitudinal location/status cannot be established from public data.

frozen_analysis_if_GO_PERFORMANCE_LINKED.population: Individuals observed as breeding adults at a known local colony in season t and belonging to a season t+1 observation occasion with explicit detection structure.
frozen_analysis_if_GO_PERFORMANCE_LINKED.performance_predictor: Within site/season relative colony reproductive performance measured in t using a frozen, source-defined success metric independent of subsequent movement.
frozen_analysis_if_GO_PERFORMANCE_LINKED.primary_response: multi-state transition from breeding colony at t to same colony versus another observed breeding colony at t+1, with nondetection treated as an observation process rather than dispersal or mortality
frozen_analysis_if_GO_PERFORMANCE_LINKED.preferred_model: multi-state capture-recapture / hidden-state model with colony state and detection probability; conditional-on-resighting logistic analysis is allowed only as a prespecified sensitivity
frozen_analysis_if_GO_PERFORMANCE_LINKED.primary_prediction: higher prior colony performance increases same-colony retention / decreases transition to another breeding colony
required_controls_if_available: individual random effect or repeated-history structure

natal_settlement_secondary.eligibility: known-age birds with natal colony and first confirmed breeding colony
natal_settlement_secondary.question: Does first breeding settlement favor colonies with higher recent reproductive performance after accounting for natal affinity and availability?
natal_settlement_secondary.boundary: This is distinct from the previously rejected 4-5-year aggregate recruitment-echo prediction.

minimum_information_if_GO.movement_primary: At least 100 individuals with >=2 breeding-season observations and at least 20 observed between-colony transitions; otherwise STOP movement-effect inference without lowering thresholds.
minimum_information_if_GO.performance_alignment: At least 8 predictor seasons and >=3 candidate local colonies per season with valid performance states.

claim_boundaries: Nondetection is never coded as death or dispersal without an explicit detection model.
Raw chick count alone is not accepted as colony reproductive performance because colony size can generate the count.
Do not infer public-information use merely from movement toward successful colonies; persistent habitat quality remains an alternative.
Do not inspect movement histories before the schema gate decision is committed.
Do not combine this individual-level lane with the colony-level cross-system Stouffer test.
